svg.title: The Key: Iron-gall botanical plate
svg.desc: The Key (1D): a botanical plate in brown iron-gall ink. On the left a crystal-bark specimen is drawn leaf by leaf, with calipers measuring a leaf and a ruler beneath. On the right the branching couplet key: the lit couplet asks for the glow period, and because the specimen reached a name whose altitude it contradicts, a new couplet is being written into the key in pencil.
